# Bustan Energy

> Bustan Energy Co., Ltd. Solar and battery planning, installation and ongoing care for Koh Phangan homes, villas, resorts and businesses.

English and Thai pages are published. The Hebrew page is the homepage: https://bustan-energy.com/he
Service area: Ko Phangan, Ko Samui, Surat Thani, and Thailand.

## Services

- Residential Solar: https://bustan-energy.com/services/residential
- Commercial Solar: https://bustan-energy.com/services/commercial
- Off-Grid Solar & Battery: https://bustan-energy.com/services/off-grid
- O&M Services: https://bustan-energy.com/services/maintenance
- Solar Farms (on the services page): https://bustan-energy.com/services#farm
- Battery Storage (on the services page): https://bustan-energy.com/services#battery
- Services overview: https://bustan-energy.com/services
- Thai services overview: https://bustan-energy.com/th/services

Solar EPC, PPA, PEA coordination, and O&M for Ko Phangan homes and businesses.
